reviews.title: Great AIO
reviews.comment: This AIO is great and keeps my intel I5 13600k nice and cool! So far temps have only maxed out a 54c and I am not going to complain about that. Later on I will upgrade to a newer model with a display screen in the pump but I am very happy with this buy.
reviews.author: ChrisG

reviews.title: Nice RGB CPU liquid cooler
reviews.comment: Installed this on my DIY desktop build as case white too.  Keeps CPU cool and nice RGB lighting from fans.  Price just dropped $10 also so even better.
reviews.author: Murrgirl

reviews.title: Great water cooler.
reviews.comment: Keeps my 5700x at 65 degrees Celsius while overclocked to 4.6.
